title: QA Tester
description:
**Date posted:** 23rd oct, 26

**Pay:** ₹18,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

**Experience:** 2-4yrs

**Job description:**

Digitex Technologies is looking for a Full-time Testing Engineer with Knowledge in Manual Testing and automation Testing, Test Case Design, and Mysql.

**Key Responsibilities**  
1.Perform manual and automated testing of Laravel-based applications and WordPress websites/plugins.  
2.Develop, document, and execute test cases, test plans, and test scripts.  
3.Identify, record, and track bugs, issues, and inconsistencies using tools like Jira, Trello, or similar.  
4.Verify front-end and back-end functionality, including APIs, database operations, and integrations.  
5.Test themes, plugins, and custom modules for WordPress to ensure compatibility and performance.  
6.Validate cross-browser and cross-device responsiveness. It includes MacOS, iOS, Windows, Linux compatibility check.  
7.Conduct regression testing, UAT, performance, and security testing as needed.  
8.Work closely with developers, designers, and project managers to deliver high-quality software.  
9.Ensure adherence to QA standards and provide feedback for process improvements.

**Required Skills**  
1.Strong knowledge of Laravel framework testing (PHPUnit, Pest, Laravel Dusk).  
2.Experience testing WordPress core, plugins, and custom themes.  
3.Familiarity with PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript basics (for debugging and verification).  
4.Knowledge of automation frameworks (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright preferred).  
5.Understanding of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins).  
6.Familiarity with performance and security testing tools (e.g., Lighthouse, OWASP ZAP).  
7.Excellent analytical, communication, and documentation skills.  
8.Experience in Agile/Scrum environments.

**Perks and Benefits :**

1. 5 days working  
2. Paid Sick leave  
3. Competitive salary package  
4. Work with the latest upgradation

Job Type: Full-time

**Benefits:**

* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

title: QA Tester & Research Analyst
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented, analytical, and proactive individual with an interest in technology, quality assurance, and research. The ideal candidate should have a basic understanding of software testing, strong research abilities, and a commitment to accuracy and continuous improvement.

Candidates with 1–2 years of relevant experience are preferred. Freshers with relevant training, certifications, or practical project experience are also welcome to apply.

Key Responsibilities: Product Quality & Testing

* Test website features, user workflows, forms, navigation, and interactive elements to identify errors and unexpected behaviour.
* Perform manual testing, including functional, regression, smoke, sanity, and exploratory testing.
* Prepare test cases, test scenarios, and checklists based on requirements.
* Identify, document, and report bugs with clear reproduction steps and supporting evidence.
* Retest reported issues after fixes and verify that features work as expected.
* Check website responsiveness, browser compatibility, input validation, and edge cases.
* Maintain testing records and communicate findings clearly to the team.

Research & Information Verification

* Conduct structured online research using reliable sources.
* Verify information for accuracy, relevance, and completeness.
* Identify inconsistencies, duplicate entries, outdated details, and missing information.
* Organise research findings using spreadsheets and structured records.
* Maintain clear documentation and source references.
* Compare information from multiple sources and identify discrepancies.
* Ensure information is organised, consistent, and up to date.

Documentation & Quality Improvement

* Maintain test cases, bug reports, research records, and quality checklists.
* Identify recurring issues and suggest practical improvements.
* Collaborate with team members to resolve problems and improve quality.
* Follow established processes and complete assigned tasks within agreed timelines.

Tools & Technical Knowledge

Familiarity with the following tools is preferred:

* **Bug tracking:** Jira, Trello, or similar issue-tracking tools.
* **Browser testing:** Chrome DevTools for basic website inspection.
* **Documentation:** Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
* **API testing:** Basic Postman knowledge is an advantage.

Advanced programming skills are not required. Practical knowledge, problem-solving ability, and willingness to learn are important.

Preferred Qualifications

* A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory.
* Candidates with 1–2 years of relevant experience in software testing, quality assurance, research, or data verification will be preferred.
* Freshers with relevant training, certifications, internships, or practical projects are encouraged to apply.
* Candidates with demonstrable practical skills and a strong learning attitude will also be considered.

Who Should Apply?

* Candidates with hands-on experience in testing, research, or quality-related work.
* Freshers who have completed relevant training or developed practical skills through projects.
* Individuals who are curious, organised, and comfortable working with digital tools and information.
* Candidates who can identify problems, verify details, and communicate findings clearly.
* Individuals who demonstrate initiative, accountability, and attention to detail.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹16,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Quality Engineering Arch Senior Analyst
description:
**Skill required:** Tech for Operations - Automated Testing  
**Designation:** QA Engineer  
**Qualifications:**Post Graduate in any discipline
  
**Years of Experience:**5 to 8 years
  
**About Accenture**  
Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
  
**What would you do?** Our Service Supply Chain offering combines proprietary technology with client systems to design, execute, and deliver BPaaS and managed services across the Plan, Deliver, and Recover lifecycle. As a Business SME, you will partner with business development to shape resilient solutions that improve clients supply chains and customer experience. Join us to drive meaningful impact and build what is next. The QA Engineer is a detail-oriented, motivated individual who works with a team will ensure the highest levels of quality assurance for our software applications. The QA Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, and running QA processes including automatic testing, test planning and defect tracking. The ideal candidate is a person experienced with creating repeatable and scalable testing solutions along with tracking and reporting on test result  
**What are we looking for?** • Proven experience in software development projects in various lifecycle phases include design, build, implementation, and steady state. • Minimum of 5 years of experience in working as a QA engineer. • Proven experience in writing testing cases, plans and test schedules. • Key Skills- Python, Java, SQL, Postman, REST API automation testing, Playwright, Selenium, Azure Test Plan • Experience with testing functional and non-functional components. • Strong experience with implementing and managing automated testing tools. • Experience with automated reporting and live monitoring of test cases. • Postman (Software) - P2 • REST API Testing - P2 • Playwright - P2
  
**Roles and Responsibilities:** • Lead and support the development of frameworks and operating models for building out test cases, plans and schedules. • Design, build and implement automated testing tools and workflows. • Develop standards and metrics for measuring testing success or failures. • Work closely with engineering teams to incorporate testing into both code and data pipelines. • Create detailed and well-structured test plans and test cases. • Conduct root cause analysis activities and risk analysis. • Estimate, prioritize and plan testing activities. • Drive innovation and streamline the overall testing process. • Lead and support testing of multiple applications and dataset simultaneously • Track quality assurance metrics such as defect densities and open defect counts • Understand business needs and objectives. • Maintain strict data security controls and standards. • Adhere to data management best practices and maintain detailed documentation.

  
Post Graduate in any discipline
